anchors.value: the ASIN mark is a glyph in his original sense: an artifact that carries its own language. Ace's spin is not cosmetic — the logo ships as a pngbind-bound artifact: signed binding in its own metadata (snapshot id, content hash, release class), verifiable by any holder without an index
